description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter class, which contains business logic for importing recipes into a different project, including methods for building ingredient data, identifying candidate matches for articles and units, and performing the import operation.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter
classes.description: A class encapsulating the logic for importing recipes into a different project, including candidate identification and data import methods.

methods.name: _build_ingredients
methods.description: Builds and returns the sorted ingredients list for the recipe.

methods.name: _build_source_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source articles related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_source_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source units related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_target_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target articles from the project for matching.

methods.name: _build_target_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target units from the project for matching.

methods.name: BUILD
methods.description: Initializes ingredient hashrefs with linked source article and unit data based on IDs.

methods.name: identify_candidates
methods.description: Identifies candidate matches between source and target articles and units based on specified keys.

methods.name: import_data
methods.description: Performs the import of recipe data into the project, creating new recipe and ingredient records.
